description:
cmux puts your coding agents in your pocket. Message Chief, the agent that runs your other agents, and it reports back in one conversation, the way a teammate would.

• Ask for a fix, a review or a status check. Chief hands the work to your coding agents and tells you how it went.
• A Cloud Chief runs in cmux Cloud, so it keeps working and answers even while your Mac is asleep, or if you don't use a Mac at all.
• Attach photos and files, or send a voice note. Voice notes become text on your iPhone.
• Call Chief from the app, Siri, Shortcuts or the Action Button and talk it through. Calls use your own API key.

Every conversation with Chief and your agents sits in one list on Home. Pin the ones that matter, mark them read and search them all.

Know when an agent needs you. Notifications tell you about questions, permission requests, finished tasks and errors that stop an agent, and you answer from your iPhone.

Use cmux on a Mac too? Sign in with the same account and your Mac shows up by itself. Open its workspaces, follow its agents' chats with Claude and Codex, review diffs and preview files.

Require Face ID to open cmux, and delete your account at any time from Settings.

cmux for iPhone requires a cmux account.
promotionalText: Chief runs your coding agents and reports back in one conversation. Ask from anywhere, answer their questions, and know the moment an agent needs you.
